title: What Remains Out of View
description: METR's assessment draws demands for deeper oversight, chip-export approvals face scrutiny, and Alex Stamos argues that defense remains expensive as AI attacks become cheaper.

metr-report-backlash.topic: The METR report's aftermath includes a canceled compute check and a New York legislator's call to prohibit RSI
metr-report-backlash.verification_scope: Full Verge article. METR's report, McCandlish's X post and the posts by Bores and Kokotajlo were not opened separately for this issue. Their positions follow The Verge.

nvidia-china-vetting.topic: Reports scrutinize an empty H200 buyer's office and an intelligence allegation involving a Megaspeed executive
nvidia-china-vetting.date_note: November 7, 2026; The Verge 15:43 UTC, TechCrunch 21:17 UTC
nvidia-china-vetting.verification_scope: Two Verge articles and TechCrunch. Paywalled New York Times and Financial Times originals were not opened. Related facts follow these secondary reports, and intelligence-memo claims are unverified.

stamos-security-dark-age.topic: Alex Stamos says open-weight models can automate much of the attack chain as defense remains costly
stamos-security-dark-age.verification_scope: The full Decoder interview transcript published by The Verge. These are Stamos's views and accounts. The $900 investigation cost, patch counts and $100 million proposal were not independently verified.

hyperflow-h3-flash.topic: Video Rebirth releases HyperFlow H3 Flash, reducing MiniMax-H3 to roughly fourteen billion parameters
hyperflow-h3-flash.date_note: November 6, 2026; GitHub 1.0.0 commit at 12:09 UTC, 48-hour catch-up

hyperflow-h3-flash.license: Code Apache 2.0, with some GPL-3.0/MIT components. Weights use the MiniMax H3 community license, excluding the EU, UK, South Korea and U.S. without authorization.

embedded-assessments-paper.topic: Embedded assessments give independent evaluators employee-like access inside AI developers
embedded-assessments-paper.date_note: arXiv v1 submitted September 21, 2026; related-paper retrospective
embedded-assessments-paper.verification_scope: arXiv 2609.25413 v1 PDF, executive summary pages 2–5, introduction pages 6–7, recommendations and table 5 on pages 32–35, and the contents headings for seven design questions in section 3. coverage_gaps.xAI: Static news cards did not establish browser-rendered coverage of all updates in the window.

coverage_gaps.arXiv cs.AI / cs.LG / cs.CL: The latest API publication timestamp was November 5 at 18:59:42 UTC, before the window start. The new-listing page still showed Friday, November 6. No newer announcement was visible through cutoff.

coverage_gaps.字节跳动 Seed·博客与论文: Visible research cards predated the window, and the featured list did not establish the full update stream.
coverage_gaps.MiniMax·News & Updates: Dates and undated NEW product labels did not establish a complete list of updates within the window.
